extraction: Vanguard, founded 1975 and one of the largest global investment managers, is staffing its new Hyderabad technology centre and hiring a Product Manager, Specialist to lead the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product with divisional implications. The work is classic enterprise digital product management: lead planning, development and implementation of a new digital product, define and analyze markets, develop detailed product features, requirements and implementation plans, and manage the entire lifecycle from planning through execution. It also includes coaching digital product teams toward best practices, partnering with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues and driving escalations for rapid delivery, employing qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve user experience, researching market conditions and emerging consumer trends, and preparing product documentation that supports marketing and sales. Qualifications are a minimum of 5 years of product management or related work experience with two years of project management preferred, a bachelor's (B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc./BBA) in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, and financial services or function-specific domain experience as an advantage; desirable extras are agile methodologies, product development tools, data analytics tools, customer engagement platforms and certifications such as CSPO, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager or Pragmatic Product Management. The role is hybrid and full-time, sits in Financial Services, and Vanguard frames the India office around AI, mobile and cloud technologies even though the role description itself is domain-agnostic.
